items.title: Live updates: Binance says $6.34B set aside to cover hack losses
items.summary: Follow live updates as Binance says $6.3 billion in assets have been stolen in a major hack. Around $3 billion in stolen funds have been frozen.

items.title: Binance working with FBI to recover assets following $6.3B hack
items.summary: Binance is working with law enforcement to recover $3 billion that is frozen, after setting aside more than $6.3 billion for user coverage.

items.title: Bitcoin price metrics hint at rebound as $1.6B liquidations follow Binance hack
items.summary: Bitcoin held above $76,000 after a $6.3 billion Binance hack and a tech-stock sell-off.

items.title: Binance Finds 'Additional Points of Breach' in $6.3B Hack
items.summary: CEO Richard Teng said the attack was not a single one-click action, about $3 billion frozen.

items.title: TRM and Chainalysis Tie $6.4B Binance Hack to North Korea's TraderTraitor
items.summary: On-chain firms link the record hack to the North Korean TraderTraitor group.

items.title: Bitcoin slides below $77,000, BNB drops amid Binance hack
items.summary: BNB lost 7.1%, while Binance Co-CEO Yi He pledged that the exchange will cover all user losses.

items.title: Polymarket resumes trading after $2.65 million exploit
items.summary: After over $2.5 million was lost within minutes on Polymarket, the platform said it has since placed its exchange in cancel-only mode.

items.title: Crypto liquidations jump to $1.57 billion as Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether lower
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $77,350 after $6.3 billion Binance hack, with crypto futures liquidations jumping to $1.57 billion.

items.title: Here's how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance's $6 billion loss
items.summary: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.

items.title: Blockchain Firms Link North Korea to $6.3 Billion Binance Hack
items.summary: Blockchain firms have linked the massive Binance hack to North Korean actors.

items.title: Tyler Evans: Bitcoin ETF Flows Flipped From Highly Negative to Strong Accumulation
items.summary: ETF flows for Bitcoin have turned positive after earlier outflows.

items.title: Bitcoin mining difficulty hits 148 trillion as revenues fall to three-month lows
items.summary: At October 30's hashprice, a 25 J/TH rig covers power costing about 5.45 cents/kWh after an assumed 2% pool fee.

items.title: Polymarket suffers second multimillion-dollar security breach in just four months
items.summary: Polymarket hit by another exploit shortly after the previous incident.

items.title: Israel Extradites Alleged Nomad Bridge Exploiter to US Over $2.8M Theft: Report
items.summary: An alleged exploiter of the Nomad Bridge has been extradited.

items.title: Will gold's 'infinite mint bug' make Bitcoin more valuable?
items.summary: A US fusion startup says it has turned mercury into gold. Could a potential increase in the gold supply strengthen Bitcoin's claim to be a better form of digital gold?

items.title: Strategy's preferred-stock fix sets up renewed bitcoin buying, analysts say
items.summary: Analysts see the preferred stock move as positive for further BTC accumulation by Strategy.

items.title: Wall Street analysts urge investors to buy crypto stocks after $6.3 billion Binance hack
items.summary: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the $6.3 billion Binance hack is unlikely to derail the crypto market's recovery.

items.title: Alex Thorn: 50-Week Signal Says Bitcoin's Bottom is In
items.summary: A technical signal suggests Bitcoin may have found a bottom.
